# OpenSignet

> OpenSignet is the agent-native identity and communications infrastructure.

Domains, DNS, email, onchain identity and payments support that definition. Developers use
the API and SDKs directly, people guide agents, and permissioned autonomous workflows act
within the authority their owners grant.

## Product

- [Home](https://opensignet.com/): Product overview and workflow.
- [Pricing](https://opensignet.com/pricing): The Free plan and the Plus, Pro, Max and Enterprise plans, which apply to the whole account; plans are paid by card or in USDC on Base.
- [Register](https://opensignet.com/register): Search a domain, choose a stack and register it, paid in USDC on Base.
- [Support](https://opensignet.com/support): Email support, guides, connecting AI tools and security reports.
- [Sign in](https://opensignet.com/sign-in): Google, a one-time email code or a wallet; every account comes with its own wallet that acts only on the owner's approval.

## Capabilities

- [AI agent identity](https://opensignet.com/ai-agent-identity)
- [Domains for AI agents](https://opensignet.com/domains-for-ai-agents)
- [Email for AI agents](https://opensignet.com/email-for-ai-agents)
- [DNS for AI agents](https://opensignet.com/dns-for-ai-agents)
- [Domain registration API](https://opensignet.com/domain-registration-api)
- [x402 agent payments](https://opensignet.com/x402-agent-payments)
- [Onchain agent identity](https://opensignet.com/onchain-agent-identity)
- [Autonomous agent renewals](https://opensignet.com/autonomous-agent-renewals)
- [MCP integration](https://opensignet.com/integrations/mcp)
- [Coinbase AgentKit integration](https://opensignet.com/integrations/coinbase-agentkit)

## Developers

- [Documentation](https://docs.opensignet.com/): Guides, API reference, SDK and MCP server.
- [Documentation index for agents](https://docs.opensignet.com/llms.txt): Machine-readable documentation map.
- [Public source](https://github.com/OpenSignetOrg/opensignet): Apache-2.0 SDK, MCP server, plugins and frontend.

The public API base is `https://api.opensignet.com/api/v1`. Keep secrets and payment
authorization outside model context, and require trusted human approval before paid actions.
